items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: We had quite a bit of work, and we got more money that, uh, Tommy Brown than we did with Jack.

ctx.x: flannel under shirt too. That's true. In the summertime. Well now, uh, what's, uh, the outfit that you remember, uh, that you played with in your audience before you left here?

Yeah, before you left there? Oh, well, I was working with Tommy Brown then. Uh, Tommy Brown in a regular outfit. Yeah, I was playing guitar with him. Uh, huh. You see? They had, uh, Gus Miller on clarinet, Raymond Lopez on trumpet, Tommy Brown on trombone, Bill Lambert on drums, and Steve Brown on bass, and myself on guitar. That was a band. Well, those days, Tommy had cut deeply into Jack Lane, uh, as far as work is concerned. We had quite a bit of work, and we got more money that, uh, Tommy Brown than we did…
a dollar and a half all day long at Millenburg or West End. What about baseball games? You all played out the Ironman Park?

items.q: He knows Arnold Leuco knows that the Rocker didn't.

ctx.x: Poor Nick LaRocca never played no funeral. He couldn't play a funeral.
